name: SyncDarkroom
subtitle: Edit photos right in your synced folder.
description: SyncDarkroom is an iPad photo editor that works directly on a folder kept in sync (for example with Synctrain/Syncthing). Edits are saved as copies next to the originals, with adjustable settings that sync too.

versions.localizedDescription:
Search, people, Immich-style map, cleanup cache and sharing

- Search tab: describe a photo (on-device CLIP), or search by metadata, objects and people, with filters
- People: faces grouped automatically; name, merge, hide and correct them
- Map: real heat map like Immich, groups always on land, date filters, photos in view; GPS 0,0 hidden
- Find Photos to Delete: remembers its analysis, Ignore option per category, no more jumping list
- Share photos to Mail, Messages, WhatsApp, Messenger and more

Map, statistics and cleanup

- Map tab: see where your photos were taken, with groups and a heat map
- Folder statistics
- Find photos to delete: screenshots, photos of screens, duplicates, blurry shots
- Rotate photos 90° from the viewer (lossless)
- Replace the original with an edit
- Pinch and twist to crop and straighten
- Edited copies now sort at the date the photo was taken
- New app icon

Faster library navigation and cleanup

- Long-press a photo and drag to select a range (auto-scrolls at the edges)
- Delete photos from the library or the viewer
- Fast-scroll column showing the month and year while you drag

First release

- Browse a Synctrain/Syncthing folder; edits are saved as copies next to the originals
- Light, color, curves, HSL, presets, RAW develop, crop and perspective
- Masks, healing, Apple Pencil markup, batch edits

apps.name: SyncDarkroom
apps.subtitle: Photo editor for synced folders
apps.localizedDescription: Browse a Synctrain/Syncthing folder and edit photos non-destructively: light, color, curves, HSL, presets, RAW develop, crop and perspective, masks, healing, Apple Pencil markup and batch edits. Originals are never modified — every edit is a new copy, and its settings sync with the folder.
